_docs: Fund-portfolio discovery (discover.py, monthly GitHub Action - never on the alert path). Pulls each fund's portfolio, keeps robotics/hardware/autonomy companies, resolves + live-verifies their ATS board, and opens a PR with a REPORT only. It never writes config.json: copy approved slugs in by hand. Endpoints below were verified live 2026-11-12; a fund that breaks shows up as FAILED in the report with the reason.

funds.name: Root Ventures
funds._note: No job board. root.vc is a terminal-style SPA; the portfolio is only in its schema.org JSON-LD (Organization nodes whose funder is Root).

funds.name: Construct Capital
funds._note: No job board. Webflow CMS list, paginated with ?<listid>_page=N links.

_keywords_note: Matched (case-insensitive) against company name + description. Kept on any hit. Qualified on purpose after a live run let these through: bare 'embedded' (embedded finance), 'silicon' (Silicon Valley), 'sensors', 'computer vision', 'autonom'/'autonomy' (AI agents; 'independence and autonomy'), 'chip' ('blue-chip brands', 'chip isolation'), 'edge AI' ('cutting-edge AI'). Bare 'hardware' is kept and still admits some software companies ('hardware and software'); review those in the PR.
_tags_note: Getro/Consider industry tags, matched EXACTLY (whole tag, case-insensitive). The generic 'Hardware' tag is excluded on purpose: Getro auto-applies it to mortgage, fintech and dev-tool companies (191 of 1,152 companies on 2026-11-12).
_ats_note: Platforms vigil's adapters support. Workday entries are only resolved from a link on the company's careers page (tenant/site can't be guessed).
